results.label: Accepted
results.description: The command request was accepted by its authoritative service.

results.label: No change
results.description: The request was valid but authoritative state already matched it.

results.label: Unavailable
results.description: The registered operation is not currently available.

results.label: Invalid arguments
results.description: One or more invocation arguments failed the registered value contract.

results.label: Not found
results.description: The current native facade could not resolve the requested object.
results.notes: Distinct current native result; not silently aliased to missingTarget.

results.label: Validation failed
results.description: The authoritative service rejected the request after domain validation.

results.label: Queue full
results.description: The bounded command queue had no available capacity.

results.label: Safety rejected
results.description: An authoritative safety gate rejected the request.

results.label: Unsupported
results.description: The current implementation does not support the registered operation for this target.

results.label: Internal error
results.description: The authoritative service failed without accepting the request.

results.label: Missing target
results.description: Reserved typed outcome for an unavailable stable target; not a native result yet.

results.label: Cancelled
results.description: Reserved typed outcome for a cancelled asynchronous operation; not a native result yet.

results.label: Started asynchronously
results.description: Reserved non-terminal outcome carrying a bounded operation identity; not a native result yet.
